title: Dirty rectangles
description:
Collect the parts of the window that need repainting and redraw only those.

```
invalidate (10, 10, 50, 50), then (40, 40, 100, 80)
update region bounds: (10, 10, 100, 80)
paint: 2 small rectangles redrawn instead of the whole 800x600 window
area saved: 99%
```
hints: The bounds are the smallest `left`/`top` and the largest `right`/`bottom` (lesson 4.01).
Overlapping rectangles count their shared area twice; that is fine for an estimate.
requirements: Keep a list of invalid rectangles; merge one into another when it is inside it.
Report the bounding box (what `BeginPaint`'s `rcPaint` gives) and the total area.
stretch: Draw into a back buffer and copy only the dirty parts to the screen.
